xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
NOTES :

1. The Board of Directors have declared an Interim Dividend of Rs.2.50 (Rupees Two and Paise Fifty Only) per share (bearing face value Rs.2/- each share) for F.Y. 2026-27, at their meeting held on October 23, 2026.
2. The above Statement of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 ("Unaudited Financial Results") comprising of the financial results of Supreme Petrochem Ltd, the parent Company, and its subsidiary Xmold Polymers Pvt Ltd ("Xmold") (together referred to as Group) have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down under the provisions of the Indian Accounting Standard 34 "Interim Financial Reporting" (Ind AS-34) as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 ("the Act") and relevant rules thereto, in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.

3. These Unaudited Financial Results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of Company at their respective meetings held on October 23, 2026. The Statutory Auditor of the Company has conducted a limited review of the said Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and have expressed an unmodified conclusion on the Unaudited Financial Results.

4. The Group operates in 'Styrenics and Allied Products' which in terms of Ind AS-108 "Operating Segments" constitutes a single reportable business segment.

5. Finance cost significantly comprises of interest expense on lease pertaining to Ind AS 116-Leases. The Company continues to remain debt free.

6. The Company does not have any joint venture or associate falling within the requisite control parameters, as defined under the provisons of Ind AS.
